howToRegenerate: node scripts/check-content.mjs --print-baseline  (prints this shape; it never writes it)
scores: content words only; sentences split on terminal punctuation only. A pair is a pair when it shares >=3 content words and (Jaccard >= 0.45 or overlap >= 0.5). Overlap is shared words over the SHORTER sentence, because a paraphrase of a long sentence scores low on Jaccard alone.

statusMeaning.open: the repeat is real and unruled: the gate stays green on it; deleting one side or taking a ruling is the exit
statusMeaning.deliberate: the repeat is the point of the surface - a source line or a ruling says so, in why
statusMeaning.template: identical row furniture on sibling rows: one string rendered twice. Coupling, not duplication - if one row changes, both must
